title: 여행 이야기: 어디를 구경하고 뭘 샀어요?
objective: By the end, you can use ten travel words such as 경치, 관광지, 기념품, 구경하다 and 추억 in short past-tense sentences about a trip you took.
summary: Ten everyday words for talking about a trip you took: the views, the places, the souvenirs and the memories.

task.title: Use the travel words
task.line: Read each item, then choose, match, check, or order the words as the instruction says.

words.meaning: view, scenery (what you see from a place)
words.example: 산 위에서 본 경치가 정말 멋있었어요.
words.exampleMeaning: The view from the top of the mountain was really amazing.

words.meaning: tourist spot, place people visit on trips
words.exampleMeaning: Gyeongju has a lot of historical tourist sites.
I bought key rings as souvenirs for my friends.

words.meaning: to look around, to see the sights
words.exampleMeaning: While looking around the market, I found a great rice cake shop.

words.example: 가족과 함께 간 제주도 여행은 좋은 추억이 됐어요.
words.exampleMeaning: The trip to Jeju with my family became a good memory.

words.meaning: to be famous (for something: N(으)로 유명하다)
words.example: 이 식당은 비빔밥으로 유명해서 줄이 길어요.
words.exampleMeaning: This restaurant is famous for its bibimbap, so the line is long.
It was a long holiday, so the airport was crowded with people.

words.meaning: to stop by, to drop in on the way
words.example: 서울로 돌아오는 길에 휴게소에 잠깐 들렀어요.
words.exampleMeaning: On the way back to Seoul, we stopped at a rest area for a moment.

words.meaning: a place to stay (hotel, guesthouse, etc.)
words.example: 숙소가 바다 바로 앞이라서 아침마다 산책했어요.
words.exampleMeaning: Our place was right by the sea, so I took a walk every morning.

words.meaning: to keep (photos, memories) to remember something
words.exampleMeaning: Before leaving, I took some photos at the beach to remember it.

exercises: Choose the right word: ① 전망대에 올라가니까 도시의 (경치 / 기념품)이/가 다 보였어요. ② 졸업 여행에서 친구들과 사진을 많이 (남겼어요 / 붐볐어요).
Fill in the blank with 붐비다 or 들르다 in the past polite form (-았/었어요): ① 어제는 출근 시간이라서 지하철이 너무 ____. ② 공항에 가기 전에 편의점에 잠깐 ____.
Write the word from the list (숙소 / 기념품 / 관광지 / 경치) that matches each description: ① the place where you sleep during a trip ② something you buy to remember a place ③ a place that many tourists visit
Is the word used correctly? Write O or X: ① 박물관에서 옛날 그림을 구경했어요. ② 어제 저녁에 숙제를 구경했어요. ③ 이 도시는 깨끗한 바다로 유명해요. ④ 시장에 사람이 없어서 아주 붐볐어요.
Put the words in the right order to make a sentence (any grammatical order is accepted): 추억이 / 사진을 보면 / 생각나요 / 그때의
answers: ① 숙소 ② 기념품 ③ 관광지
① O ② X ③ O ④ X
사진을 보면 그때의 추억이 생각나요. (또는 그때의 추억이 사진을 보면 생각나요.)
